name: Circumplex of Interpersonal Behaviors (CABIN)
instruction: Please rate how characteristic each behavior is of your interaction with others (1 = Not at all characteristic, 5 = Extremely characteristic).

items.text: I set firm boundaries and stand my ground.
I assert my viewpoint clearly in discussions.
I actively take charge and lead group activities.
I express strong initiative in making decisions.
I share my feelings openly with friends.
I seek close companionship and intimacy.
I show warmth and affection toward my partners.
I offer comfort when someone is distressed.
I tend to yield when disagreements arise.
I follow others' lead rather than steering.
I prefer accommodating others' wishes.
I keep quiet about my own grievances.
I maintain emotional distance from peers.
I prefer solving personal dilemmas alone.
I am slow to open up to new acquaintances.
I guard my privacy guarded fiercely.
I express enthusiastic appreciation for others.
I uplift colleagues with encouraging feedback.
I celebrate others' achievements with joy.
I show genuine excitement when reuniting.
I critique flawed arguments directly and bluntly.
I challenge dubious statements made by peers.
I point out inconsistencies without sugarcoating.
I resist unverified peer pressure.
